data.body: Re-verified on main 58bb75d (2026-10-12), 166 commits after the audit tree 0c7d60a. PARTLY ADDRESSED, still open. Closed half: the position tell now runs schedule.arrange on synthetic nights and reads the wall's order (commit 4ac7ce3; audit.py:10, tell_pool(questions, arrange); test_audit.py:614-643 'the command line measures the real arrangement'), and arrange itself raises if the arranged answer is not at slot_for_day(day) (schedule.py:209-210). Remaining work: lint arrange like the slot path (no bank, used or ledger reads; no draw for the answer but slot_for_day). Re-run mutant M1c to confirm.
